method: Manual inspection of actual app screenshots, native collection frame, plotted measurements and wide/narrow browser captures, plus automated interaction checks.
observations: New selector fits the existing integrated controls.
Native post-collection frame shows the powered-up character with its proper sprite.
Live return and wait captures show the corresponding actual status.
History retains the selected strategy and simple comparison; failure remains stopped/refused.
Compact app view retains accessible chat and game controls.
Guide text and comparison details wrap at390; charts and screenshots open at full size.
Chart labels, observed ranges and measured pickup totals are legible; no claimed confidence bound.
